outcome: Prevalence of unhoused status in pregnancy
Association between unhoused status and patient and pregnancy characteristics
Delivery outcomes (severe maternal morbidity, mortality at delivery)
Choice of long-acting reversible contraception method
cohort: Pregnant patients hospitalized for vaginal and cesarean deliveries from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2020, identified from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project National (Nationwide) Inpatient Sample
finding: Unhoused status in pregnancy increased in the US from 2016 to 2020 and was associated with various risk factors and adverse pregnancy outcomes, including extreme preterm delivery, severe maternal morbidity, and mortality.
